title: Popping a represented stack
statement: For any stack tail $xs$ and symbol $a$, blanking the cell at position $-(|xs|+1)$ in the tape representation of the stack with top symbol $a$ and tail $xs$ yields the tape representation of $xs$.
hypotheses_covered: The stack is formed from a symbol $a$ followed by a tail $xs$
replaced:
Updating the work-tape representation of a nonempty stack, with top symbol $a$ above
a tail $xs$, by blanking its top cell (at position $-(\abs{xs} + 1)$) yields exactly
the representation of the popped stack $xs$.
